description: Agent IP Records: submit trademark use and specimen records with the registrations they answer to: each registration with its id, number, the application serial it issued from, the mark as registered, whether it is maintained on a use claim, the goods and services it covers and the date of first use it states; each application record with its id, serial number and the date of first use it states; each portfolio listing with its id, the registration and the date of first use it lists; each specimen or use record with its id, reference, the registration, its kind, the mark as it shows it, the goods and services it shows the mark in use for and the moment recorded; each declaration of use with its id, reference, the registration, the moment filed and the specimens filed with it. The signed report gives the registrations and the use records, each use claim against a specimen or use record on file, each date of first use across the application, the registration and the portfolio, each registered item of goods or services against the use records, and each declaration of use against the specimens it files, and counts them, and names divergent trademark use records: a registration maintained on a use claim with no specimen or use record on file, a date of first use that differs across the application, the registration and the portfolio, a mark recorded as in use for goods the use records do not cover, and a declaration of use filed with specimens that do not match the recorded mark; then a specimen a declaration names with no record of it on file and a use record naming a registration the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No registrations, or a registration on a use claim with no goods or services stated, leaves those points unverified. Registrations, applications, portfolio listings, use records, specimens and declarations match by letters and digits, an application to its registration by the serial it issued from, dates of first use compare by the day, an item of goods or services reads as covered when its words and a use record’s words agree with plurals folded, and marks compare by their words without case, punctuation or the registration signs. This reads whether each trademark is in use as the register and the portfolio say. Verdict ip_use_divergent, ip_use_partial, ip_use_unverified or ip_use_consistent. POST /api/ip-use-check. Reads the intellectual property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no application, pays no fee, contacts no patent or trademark office or attorney and gives no legal advice, which stay with the owner, its IP counsel and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent IP Records reads a business’s own intellectual property records: trademark and patent application records, registration records, prosecution and office-action records, renewal and maintenance records, assignment and chain-of-title records as recorded at the IP office, license records, use and specimen records and docket records, each against the application, registration and docket records, the filing receipts and exhibits on file, the responses and the portfolio, the registrations, the register’s chain of title, the register records, the use records or the matters and filings on record. The family’s ground is the office record behind the brand and the invention: what was applied for, what registered, who the register says owns it, and whether the deadlines and licenses hold up; the Agent Legal family reads the contracts parties sign, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-ip-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-ip-records/.
